items.body:
一名日本公民本月18日在上海死亡，当局拘留了一名涉案日本公民。
驻上海日本总领事馆19日已接到相关通知，目前正就与被拘留的日本公民会面一事进行协调。
（TBS）

items.body:
JEANNA SMIALEK, HANNAH BEECH2026年11月20日

2017年，罗辛亚难民从缅甸逃往孟加拉国，身后的村庄燃起熊熊大火。 Adam Dean for The New York Times

The International Court of Justice ruled on Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims, a landmark decision years in the making that makes the Southeast Asian nation the first state to be held to account for violating the 1948 Genocide Convention.

国际法院周四裁定，缅甸对罗辛亚穆斯林实施了种族灭绝。这项酝酿多年的里程碑式裁决使这个东南亚国家成为首个因违反1948年《防止及惩治灭绝种族罪公约》而被追究责任的国家。

The ruling covers Myanmar’s deadly military campaign against the Rohingya minority, which killed at least 10,000 people in a few weeks in 2017 and forced three quarters of a million people to flee during that same period. More deaths and expulsions followed.

该裁决涉及缅甸对罗辛亚少数民族发动的致命军事行动。2017年，这场行动在数周内造成至少1万人死亡，并迫使75万人在此期间逃离家园。此后又发生了更多杀戮和驱逐事件。

“The Republic of the Union of Myanmar has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in Northern Rakhine state,” Judge Yuji Iwasawa, the president of the I.C.J., said while reading the court’s decision on Thursday. The decision was made by 9 votes to 6.

“缅甸联邦共和国在若开邦北部对罗辛亚群体实施了种族灭绝，”国际法院院长岩泽雄司周四宣读法院裁决时说。该裁决以九票对六票通过。

The decision could have sweeping implications, including for another genocide case before the I.C.J., the United Nations’ highest judicial body: the accusation of genocide by Israel against the people of the Gaza Strip. The ruling opens the way for the court to consider restitution, and it would be up to the U.N. Security Council whether to enforce such measures.

这项裁决可能产生广泛影响，其意义也可能延伸至联合国最高司法机构国际法院正在审理的另一宗种族灭绝案件：以色列被控对加沙地带民众实施种族灭绝。裁决为国际法院考虑要求缅甸采取补救措施铺平了道路，而是否采取措施执行裁决，则将由联合国安理会决定。

2017年，徒步逃离缅甸暴力冲突的罗辛亚难民向孟加拉国的一处难民营行进。 Tomas Munita for The New York Times

A spokeswoman for the government of Myanmar, in the capital Naypyidaw, did not answer a phone call seeking comment after the verdict was handed down. Myanmar authorities have previously disputed the charge.

判决宣布后，缅甸首都内比都的政府发言人没有接听寻求置评的电话。缅甸当局此前曾对该指控提出异议。

Among other findings, the court determined that Myanmar had failed to prevent genocide. While it was not found to have incited private people to commit genocide, the court found that it also failed to punish genocide.

法院还认定，缅甸未能防止种族灭绝发生。虽然法院没有认定缅甸煽动私人实施种族灭绝，但认定其未能惩治种族灭绝罪行。

“This is a case a decade in the making,” said Juliette McIntyre, a Senior Lecturer in Law at Adelaide University in Australia. “From the point of view of the Rohingya people, who have been waiting, and waiting, and waiting for justice, this is very important.”

“这是一个酝酿了十年的案件，”澳大利亚阿德莱德大学高级法学讲师朱丽叶·麦金太尔说。“对于一直等待、等待、再等待正义得到伸张的罗辛亚人来说，这项裁决意义重大。”

Gambia filed suit against Myanmar in 2019 in the court, which is based in The Hague. While the West African country is thousands of miles from Myanmar, international law gives countries the ability to act against genocide anywhere in the world — even if they are not affected.

2019年，冈比亚向位于海牙的国际法院起诉缅甸。虽然这个西非国家距离缅甸数千公里，但根据国际法，各国有权针对世界任何地方发生的种族灭绝行为采取法律行动，即使自身并未受到影响。

In the Jamtoli camp of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh, people thronged to a public viewing party to watch the hourslong decision, cheering and weeping as the decision was read. Some held signs that said “thank you, Gambia.”

在孟加拉国的贾姆托利罗辛亚难民营，大批民众聚集在一起，观看持续数小时的判决宣读。随着判决内容的公布，人群中响起欢呼声，也有人激动落泪。一些人举着写有“谢谢冈比亚”的标语牌。

在孟加拉国的一处难民营，罗辛亚难民观看国际法院宣读裁决的现场直播。

In The Hague, Dawda Jallow, the attorney general for Gambia, welcomed the decision to find Myanmar culpable of the “crime of crimes.” Speaking to journalists on the main staircase of the I.C.J.’s Peace Palace shortly after the ruling was read, he said, “we will stand with the Rohingya until justice is served.”

在海牙，冈比亚总检察长乌达·贾洛对法院裁定缅甸犯下这一“罪中之罪”表示欢迎。判决宣读后不久，他在国际法院和平宫主台阶对记者说：“我们将与罗辛亚人站在一起，直到正义得到伸张。”

The violence at the core of the case took place in Myanmar’s far western Rakhine state, starting in 2016 and worsening in 2017. U.N. officials and human rights groups have called it a coordinated, scorched-earth campaign to remove the Rohingya — one that involved killing, wounding and raping, razing villages, and eventually forcing the expulsion of more than a million people to neighboring Bangladesh.

这起案件的核心是发生在缅甸最西部若开邦的暴力事件，它始于2016年，2017年加剧。联合国官员和人权组织称这是一场协同一致的焦土行动，目的是将罗辛亚人赶走——行动包括杀戮、伤害、强奸、夷平村庄，最终迫使超过100万人逃往邻国孟加拉国。

The Rohingya Muslims have a long history of repression in Myanmar. After the nation’s independence from Britain in 1948, they were one of many ethnic groups in the country, which was then known as Burma. But over time, they faced increasing attacks from members of the nation’s Buddhist majority.

罗辛亚穆斯林在缅甸长期遭受压迫。1948年缅甸脱离英国独立后，罗辛亚人是这个当时被称为Burma的国家众多族裔群体之一。但随着时间推移，他们越来越频繁地遭到该国占多数的佛教徒的攻击。

A restrictive citizenship law in 1982 effectively rendered most Rohingya stateless. Various Myanmar governments, including a civilian authority led by the Nobel peace laureate Daw Aung San Suu Kyi, have refused to even acknowledge the Rohingya as a legitimate ethnic group, falsely referring to them instead as interlopers from neighboring Bangladesh.

1982年出台的一项限制性公民身份法实际上使大多数罗辛亚人沦为无国籍者。缅甸历届政府，包括诺贝尔和平奖得主昂山素季领导的文官政府，甚至拒绝承认罗辛亚人是一个合法的族群，反而错误地将他们称为来自邻国孟加拉国的闯入者。

2019年，在缅甸孟都镇区被夷为平地的罗辛亚村庄萨巴尔孔，一座遭到摧毁的清真寺遗址。

Myanmar’s military called its campaign against the Rohingya “clearance operations.” Ms. Aung San Suu Kyi defended the military at the I.C.J., denying it committed genocide, before her government was deposed by the military and she was imprisoned in 2021. (After the coup, Myanmar descended into a civil war that is still raging.) About 1.2 million Rohingya now live in dire conditions in overcrowded camps in Bangladesh. Following the eruption of Myanmar’s civil war in 2021, much of the Rohingya homeland is now controlled by a milita from the Rakhine ethnic minority, which has also been accused of persecuting Rohingya.

缅甸军方将针对罗辛亚人的军事行动称为“清剿行动”。昂山素季曾在国际法院为军方辩护，否认其犯下种族灭绝罪。后来，她的政府于2021年被军方推翻，她本人也遭到监禁。（政变后，缅甸陷入内战，战火至今未息。）如今，约有120万罗辛亚人生活在孟加拉国拥挤不堪的难民营中，处境艰难。2021年缅甸内战爆发后，罗辛亚人的大部分故土落入少数民族若开族的一支武装组织控制，而该组织也被指控迫害罗辛亚人。

Thursday’s decision hinged on whether Myanmar acted with the specific intent to physically destroy the Rohingya, in whole or in part, as an ethnic or religious group.

周四的裁决取决于缅甸是否具有特定意图，即作为一个族裔或宗教群体，全部或部分地从肉体上消灭罗辛亚人。

The court found that Myanmar took measures to wipe out the Rohingya people, who did constitute a protected ethnic group by the court’s judgment.

法院认定，罗辛亚人属于公约保护的族裔群体，而缅甸采取了旨在消灭这一群体的措施。

The case summary states that, among other atrocities, the court found that “widespread acts of extreme violence were perpetrated by the Myanmar security forces against children in northern Rakhine State,” that “in addition to the extreme hardship of the journey, the Myanmar security forces systematically shot at Rohingya as they were fleeing,” and that “the evidence demonstrates a deliberate, organized process” of destroying Rohingya villages.

根据案件摘要，法院认定的暴行包括：“缅甸安全部队在若开邦北部对儿童实施了广泛的极端暴力行为”；“除了逃亡途中遭受的极端艰难困苦，罗辛亚人在逃离时还系统性地遭到缅甸安全部队枪击”；以及“证据表明，摧毁罗辛亚人村庄的行动是一个蓄意、有组织的过程”。

“The only reasonable inference that can explain Myanmar’s actions is an intention to destroy a substantial part of the group,” Judge Iwasawa read from the ruling.

岩泽雄司法官宣读判决时说：“对缅甸行为唯一合理的解释，就是其意图消灭这一群体中的相当大一部分人。”

The court said that Myanmar must provide restitution — trying to put things back as they were, including through allowing return and reunification — and, where that fails, compensation. But the amount of compensation needed is not yet set, and will be determined in further proceedings.

法院表示，缅甸必须采取恢复原状的补救措施，尽可能让局势恢复到暴行发生前的状态，包括允许难民返回家园、与家人团聚。如果无法做到，则必须提供赔偿。不过，具体赔偿金额尚未确定，将在后续司法程序中裁定。

The court does not have the power to enforce its own rulings, and the U.N. Security Council would need to uphold the decision. Two members of the Security Council, China and Russia, may opt to protect Myanmar. Each provides Myanmar with weapons it now uses to kill civilians in the civil war.

国际法院无权自行强制执行判决，必须由联合国安理会采取行动，确保裁决得到落实。安理会成员国中国和俄罗斯可能选择保护缅甸。两国都向缅甸提供武器，而缅甸军方如今正在内战中使用这些武器杀害平民。

“Concerned governments” should “press Myanmar’s junta to comply with the judgment, and ensure the safe and voluntary return of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar,” Maria Elena Vignoli, senior international justice counsel at Human Rights Watch, said in a written statement following the announcement.

人权观察组织国际司法高级法律顾问玛丽亚·埃莱娜·维尼奥利在裁决公布后发表书面声明说，“关注此事的各国政府”应当“敦促缅甸军政府遵守判决，并确保罗辛亚难民能够安全、自愿地返回缅甸”。

Notably, the United States has previously said that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, though that happened during the Biden administration.

值得注意的是，美国此前也曾认定缅甸对罗辛亚人实施了种族灭绝，不过这一认定是在拜登政府执政期间作出的。

Jonathan Wolfe、Marlise Simons和Saikou Jammeh对本文有报道贡献。

Jeanna Smialek是《纽约时报》布鲁塞尔分社社长。

Hannah Beech是《纽约时报》记者，常驻曼谷。她报道亚洲新闻超过25年，主要报道深度和调查新闻。

The case summary states that, among other atrocities, the court found that “widespread acts of extreme violence were perpetrated by the Myanmar security forces against children in northern Rakhine State,” that “in addition to the extreme hardship of the journey, the Myanmar security forces systematically shot at Rohingya as they were fleeing,” and that “the evidence demonstrates a deliberate, organized process” of destroying Rohingya villages.
根据案件摘要，法院认定的暴行包括：“缅甸安全部队在若开邦北部对儿童实施了广泛的极端暴力行为”；“除了逃亡途中遭受的极端艰难困苦，罗辛亚人在逃离时还系统性地遭到缅甸安全部队枪击”；以及“证据表明，摧毁罗辛亚人村庄的行动是一个蓄意、有组织的过程”。
“The only reasonable inference that can explain Myanmar’s actions is an intention to destroy a substantial part of the group,” Judge Iwasawa read from the ruling.
岩泽雄司法官宣读判决时说：“对缅甸行为唯一合理的解释，就是其意图消灭这一群体中的相当大一部分人。”

The court said that Myanmar must provide restitution — trying to put things back as they were, including through allowing return and reunification — and, where that fails, compensation. But the amount of compensation needed is not yet set, and will be determined in further proceedings.
法院表示，缅甸必须采取恢复原状的补救措施，尽可能让局势恢复到暴行发生前的状态，包括允许难民返回家园、与家人团聚。如果无法做到，则必须提供赔偿。不过，具体赔偿金额尚未确定，将在后续司法程序中裁定。

The court does not have the power to enforce its own rulings, and the U.N. Security Council would need to uphold the decision. Two members of the Security Council, China and Russia, may opt to protect Myanmar. Each provides Myanmar with weapons it now uses to kill civilians in the civil war.
国际法院无权自行强制执行判决，必须由联合国安理会采取行动，确保裁决得到落实。安理会成员国中国和俄罗斯可能选择保护缅甸。两国都向缅甸提供武器，而缅甸军方如今正在内战中使用这些武器杀害平民。

“Concerned governments” should “press Myanmar’s junta to comply with the judgment, and ensure the safe and voluntary return of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar,” Maria Elena Vignoli, senior international justice counsel at Human Rights Watch, said in a written statement following the announcement.
人权观察组织国际司法高级法律顾问玛丽亚·埃莱娜·维尼奥利在裁决公布后发表书面声明说，“关注此事的各国政府”应当“敦促缅甸军政府遵守判决，并确保罗辛亚难民能够安全、自愿地返回缅甸”。
Notably, the United States has previously said that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, though that happened during the Biden administration.
值得注意的是，美国此前也曾认定缅甸对罗辛亚人实施了种族灭绝，不过这一认定是在拜登政府执政期间作出的。

Jeanna Smialek是《纽约时报》布鲁塞尔分社社长。
Hannah Beech是《纽约时报》记者，常驻曼谷。她报道亚洲新闻超过25年，主要报道深度和调查新闻。

items.body:
PETER BAKER2026年11月20日

周四在中国深圳举行的三方会晤让特朗普总统获得了一个求之不得的喘息机会。长期以来，他一直对俄罗斯总统普京和中国国家主席习近平这样的威权领导人表示钦佩。 Doug Mills/The New York Times

This was the picture President Trump wanted for years: a trio of global titans sitting down together, just the three of them, a 21st-century conclave seemingly shaping the course of world events. At least in his eyes, it projected gravity, it projected grandeur, it projected power.

这是特朗普总统多年来一直渴望的画面：三位世界级强人坐在一起，只有他们三人，仿佛一场21世纪的大国首脑密会，正在决定世界大事的走向。至少在特朗普眼中，这一幕彰显了庄重、气派和权力。

But the image of Mr. Trump flexing strength with his counterparts at a historic summit in China contrasted sharply with the drastically changing power dynamic for him back home. While he sought to use the meeting with the leaders of China and Russia to signal that he remains a giant on the international stage, Mr. Trump soon will have to share control with ascendant Democrats in Washington.

然而，在中国举行的这场历史性峰会上，特朗普与其他两位领导人共同展示实力的画面与他在国内面临的权力格局剧变形成了鲜明对比。他试图通过与中俄领导人的会晤表明自己仍是国际舞台上的重量级人物，但在华盛顿，他很快就不得不与势力上升的民主党人分享权力。

It says a lot about this president at this point in his rocky tenure that he would rather meet with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia than with Senator Chuck Schumer and Representative Hakeem Jeffries, the Democratic congressional leaders who have yet to be invited to the White House since this month’s election. He offered hugs and arm pats and broad smiles to the autocrats, even as his administration has threatened criminal investigations of Democrats who pursue aggressive oversight of his administration next year.

在这个波折不断的总统任期里，特朗普如今宁愿会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京，也不愿与参议员查克·舒默和众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯见面，这本身就很能说明问题。本月选举结束以来，舒默和杰弗里斯这两位民主党国会领袖一直没有收到白宫的邀请。特朗普向两位威权领导人送上拥抱、轻拍手臂，露出灿烂的笑容，而他的政府却威胁要对那些明年试图严格监督政府的民主党人展开刑事调查。

“We are really making history,” Mr. Trump said with a note of pride at the beginning of the trilateral meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin here in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. As leaders of the big powers, he added, the three of them were addressing “issues impacting not just our people but the entire planet.”

“我们真的在创造历史，”周四在中国深圳与习近平和普京举行三方会议开始时，特朗普带着一丝自豪说道。他还表示，作为大国领导人，他们三人正在处理“不仅影响我们的人民，也影响整个星球的问题”。

He nodded to Mr. Xi. “It’s an honor for me to be with you,” he said. Then to Mr. Putin, he said, “It’s an honor for me to be with you.”

他朝习近平点点头，说：“能和你在一起，我感到很荣幸。”随后，他又对普京说：“能和你在一起，我感到很荣幸。”

While a gripping photo op, the meeting produced no real breakthroughs, nor did it seem likely to lead to any. None of the traditional diplomatic spadework was done in advance to achieve concrete outcomes. And while the leaders issued a joint statement embracing goals like energy development and reduction of nuclear risks, it was not clear that sustained discussions would follow.

这场会晤虽然提供了极具吸引力的拍照机会，却没有取得任何实质性突破，似乎也不太可能带来突破。会晤前，各方没有进行旨在取得具体成果的传统外交准备工作。虽然三国领导人发表了联合声明，表示支持能源开发、降低核风险等目标，但尚不清楚后续是否会展开持续的磋商。

Instead, it was mainly an expression of power, which to Mr. Trump has always been the coin of the realm. Even after voters decisively repudiated him in the midterm elections, he has sought to reassert his authority by choosing a new might-makes-right White House chief of staff who has said that “the real world” is “governed by power.” In recent days, his secretaries of state and defense have questioned the extent that international laws apply to “men with swords,” which is, of course, how Mr. Trump and his testosterone-promoting team see themselves.

相反，这场会晤主要是一种权力的展示。对特朗普来说，权力始终是最重要的资本。即使选民在中期选举中明确表达了对他的否定，他仍试图重申自己的权威，为此任命了一位信奉强权即公理的新任白宫办公厅主任。此人曾表示，“现实世界”是“由权力支配的”。最近几天，特朗普的国务卿和国防部长还公开质疑，国际法在多大程度上适用于“持剑之人”。当然，这正是特朗普及其崇尚雄性气概的团队对自己的定位。

“The presidency, our presidency, is considered a strong presidency. You can do a lot,” Mr. Trump told CBS News on election night as voters were rejecting Republicans across the country, handing control of both houses of Congress to Democrats. Speaking with Fox News in Shenzhen on Thursday before his meetings, Mr. Trump emphasized that he will defy the new Congress. “They could do all the bills they want,” he said. “I just go veto, veto, veto.”

“总统职位，我们这个总统职位，被认为是一个权力很大的职位。你可以做很多事情，”特朗普在选举之夜接受CBS新闻采访时说。当时，共和党在全国各地遭到选民否定，他们将国会参众两院的控制权交给民主党。周四在深圳举行会晤之前，特朗普接受福克斯新闻采访时强调，他将对抗新一届国会。“他们想通过多少法案都行，”他说。“我只管否决、否决、否决。”

众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯是民主党在众议院的领袖。特朗普很快就不得不在华盛顿与重新掌控国会的民主党人分享权力。

Unpopular presidents who lose control of Congress often turn to international affairs where they have more latitude to operate. Mr. Trump did not need congressional approval to meet with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. But with his Iran war stalled after nine months, Mr. Trump has less room to maneuver. And foreign leaders understand that he is now a lame duck who will be out of office in just over two years.

不受欢迎的总统一旦失去对国会的控制，往往会转向国际事务，因为在那里他们拥有更大的行动自由度。特朗普不需要国会批准就能会晤习近平和普京。但由于他的伊朗战争在九个月后陷入停滞，特朗普的回旋余地更小了。外国领导人也明白，他现在是一个跛脚鸭总统，再过两年多就会卸任。

But the summit offered a welcome respite to Mr. Trump, who has long expressed admiration for authoritarian leaders like Mr. Putin and Mr. Xi, often applying the word “strong” to them, perhaps his favorite compliment. He has over the years talked enviously of their ability to get things done unburdened by the messy obstacles of legislatures and courts.

不过，对特朗普来说，这场峰会无疑是一次求之不得的喘息机会。长期以来，他一直对普京和习近平这样的威权领导人表示钦佩，经常用“强大”来形容他们，这或许是他最喜欢的赞美之词。多年来，他曾不无羡慕地谈到，这些领导人不必受到立法机关和法院种种繁琐掣肘，就能把事情办成。

Indeed, Mr. Putin later suggested that he and Mr. Trump shared a common view of “civilizational values” and a “certain closeness” in perspectives. “For instance,” Mr. Putin told reporters after the meeting, “we were just discussing issues of democracy, right? But what is democracy, really?” He went on to suggest that “is, in fact, a liberal attempt to monopolize power — a liberal dictatorship, if you will.”

事实上，普京后来表示，他与特朗普对“文明价值观”有着共同理解，在其他问题上的看法也有“一定的相通之处”。普京在会后对记者说，“比如，我们刚才还在讨论民主问题，对吧？但民主究竟是什么？”他接着说，民主“实际上是自由派试图垄断权力的一种方式——可以说是一种自由派独裁”。

In his second term, Mr. Trump has endeavored to assert executive power to a far greater degree than in his first, asserting authority to sidestep Congress and the courts. He has taken an expansive view of his office, using the Justice Department to prosecute his personal enemies, gutting congressionally authorized agencies, firing theoretically independent officials and so on.

在第二任期内，特朗普一直试图以前所未有的力度扩张行政权力，宣称自己有权绕过国会和法院行事。他对总统职权采取了极为宽泛的解释，包括利用司法部起诉自己的私敌、大幅削弱经国会授权设立的机构、解雇理论上应保持独立的官员，等等。

Asked in an interview with The New York Times in January whether he acknowledged any limits to his global power, he said: “Yeah, there is one thing. My own morality. My own mind. It’s the only thing that can stop me.”

今年1月接受《纽约时报》采访时，他被问及是否承认自己的全球权力存在任何限制，他说：“有，只有一样东西——我自己的道德，我自己的判断。这是唯一能阻止我的东西。”

Last month, he mused out loud to reporters in the Oval Office about how he could have used his power to go after Democrats like former Presidents Joseph R. Biden Jr. and Barack Obama and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, but chose not to. “I can do whatever I want, if I want,” he said.

上个月，特朗普在椭圆形办公室向记者谈起，自己本来可以利用权力追究前总统拜登、奥巴马以及前国务卿希拉里等民主党人，但最终选择没有这么做。“只要我愿意，我想做什么都可以，”他说。

Mr. Trump’s view of power goes back to his days in business. As a family-owned firm, the Trump Organization had no board of directors or shareholders to whom Mr. Trump had to answer. His decisions essentially were the final word. After he was inaugurated for his first term in 2017, he expressed shock that the government did not operate the same way.

特朗普的权力观可以追溯到他的经商岁月。作为一家家族企业，特朗普集团没有董事会或股东需要他来负责。他的决定基本上就是最终决定。2017年首次宣誓就任总统后，他曾对政府不能以同样方式运作感到震惊。

He has surrounded himself with advisers who share his view of power, and his choice of chief of staff after his party’s disastrous midterm results made clear that he has no intention of backing down.

他在身边安排了一批与自己持有相同权力观的顾问。共和党在中期选举中惨败后，他对新任白宫办公厅主任的选择表明，他丝毫没有退让的打算。

尽管选民在中期选举中明确表达了对他的否定，特朗普仍试图通过任命信奉“强权即公理”的斯蒂芬·米勒为新任白宫办公厅主任，重新确立自己的权威。

Stephen Miller, the new chief, has long voiced maximalist ideas about executive power. As a policy aide in the first Trump administration, Mr. Miller responded to a judge’s ruling striking down a ban on people from predominantly Muslim countries by saying that “the powers of the president to protect our country are very substantial and will not be questioned.”

新任办公厅主任斯蒂芬·米勒长期以来一直主张最大限度地扩大行政权力。在特朗普第一届政府担任政策顾问期间，一名法官曾推翻针对多个穆斯林人口占多数国家的入境禁令。米勒对此回应说：“总统保护我们国家的权力非常广泛，不容质疑。”

Secretary of State Marco Rubio reflected the administration’s view about the reach of its authority during a recent speech to the Federalist Society denouncing the International Criminal Court, an institution that the United States has never joined but has become a particular target of Mr. Trump lately. Among other things, the court has issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin for alleged war crimes stemming from his invasion of Ukraine.

国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥最近在联邦党人学会发表演讲，抨击国际刑事法院，反映出特朗普政府对自身权力范围的看法。美国从未加入该法院，但最近它已成为特朗普特别针对的目标。该法院曾因普京入侵乌克兰所涉战争罪指控，对普京发出了逮捕令。

“If they’re foolish enough to try to enforce their paper decrees on Americans,” Mr. Rubio said of the international court, “our answer will probably be the same as the Roman general Pompey when he said to those who were trying to invoke their cities’ charters against his legions. He said, ‘Stop quoting laws to men with swords.’”

“如果他们愚蠢到试图对美国人执行他们的一纸法令，”鲁比奥谈到该国际法院时说，“我们的回答大概会像罗马将军庞培那样。他对那些试图援引自己城市的特许状来对抗他军团的人说：‘别向持剑之人引用法律。’”

“Not politically correct to say that,” he added, “but that’s what he said. That’s what he said.”

“这么说政治不正确，”他补充道，“但他当时就是这么说的。就是这么说的。”

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth liked the idea so much that he posted a clip of Mr. Rubio online along with the line: “Stop quoting laws to MEN WITH SWORDS.”

国防部长皮特·海格塞斯非常喜欢这个说法，以至于把鲁比奥的这段视频发到网上，并附上了那句话：“别向持剑之人引用法律。”

Mr. Hegseth’s post generated criticism even from fellow conservatives who oppose American recognition of the International Criminal Court. Former Representative Justin Amash of Michigan, who left the Republican Party, called it an abandonment of the rule of law.

海格塞斯的帖子甚至招致了同样反对美国承认国际刑事法院的保守派人士的批评。已退出共和党的密歇根州前众议员贾斯廷·阿马什认为，这种说法背弃了法治原则。

“Rejecting the ICC’s jurisdiction is one thing,” he wrote online. “Declaring that laws become irrelevant the moment swords appear is another. That’s just ‘might makes right,’ which is a fundamental rejection of both Christian ethics and America’s founding.”

“拒绝承认国际刑事法院的管辖权是一回事，”他在网上写道。“宣称刀剑一出现，法律就不再重要，则是另一回事。这无非就是‘强权即公理’，从根本上否定了基督教伦理和美国的立国原则。

In Shenzhen, Mr. Trump, Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin made clear where they stood on the idea of the reach of international law. In the joint statement they released afterward, they said that immunity of state officials is “of paramount importance.” On that, at least, the leaders of America, China and Russia were on the same page.

在深圳，特朗普、习近平和普京明确表明了他们对国际法适用范围的立场。在随后发表的联合声明中，三人表示，国家官员的豁免权“至关重要”。至少在这一点上，美中俄三国领导人达成了一致。

Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。

“我们真的在创造历史，”周四在中国深圳与习近平和普京举行三方会议开始时，特朗普带着一丝自豪说道。他还表示，作为大国领导人，他们三人正在处理“不仅影响我们的人民，也影响整个星球的问题”。
He nodded to Mr. Xi. “It’s an honor for me to be with you,” he said. Then to Mr. Putin, he said, “It’s an honor for me to be with you.”
他朝习近平点点头，说：“能和你在一起，我感到很荣幸。”随后，他又对普京说：“能和你在一起，我感到很荣幸。”

While a gripping photo op, the meeting produced no real breakthroughs, nor did it seem likely to lead to any. None of the traditional diplomatic spadework was done in advance to achieve concrete outcomes. And while the leaders issued a joint statement embracing goals like energy development and reduction of nuclear risks, it was not clear that sustained discussions would follow.
这场会晤虽然提供了极具吸引力的拍照机会，却没有取得任何实质性突破，似乎也不太可能带来突破。会晤前，各方没有进行旨在取得具体成果的传统外交准备工作。虽然三国领导人发表了联合声明，表示支持能源开发、降低核风险等目标，但尚不清楚后续是否会展开持续的磋商。

Instead, it was mainly an expression of power, which to Mr. Trump has always been the coin of the realm. Even after voters decisively repudiated him in the midterm elections, he has sought to reassert his authority by choosing a new might-makes-right White House chief of staff who has said that “the real world” is “governed by power.” In recent days, his secretaries of state and defense have questioned the extent that international laws apply to “men with swords,” which is, of course, how Mr. Trump and his testosterone-promoting team see themselves.
相反，这场会晤主要是一种权力的展示。对特朗普来说，权力始终是最重要的资本。即使选民在中期选举中明确表达了对他的否定，他仍试图重申自己的权威，为此任命了一位信奉强权即公理的新任白宫办公厅主任。此人曾表示，“现实世界”是“由权力支配的”。最近几天，特朗普的国务卿和国防部长还公开质疑，国际法在多大程度上适用于“持剑之人”。当然，这正是特朗普及其崇尚雄性气概的团队对自己的定位。

“The presidency, our presidency, is considered a strong presidency. You can do a lot,” Mr. Trump told CBS News on election night as voters were rejecting Republicans across the country, handing control of both houses of Congress to Democrats. Speaking with Fox News in Shenzhen on Thursday before his meetings, Mr. Trump emphasized that he will defy the new Congress. “They could do all the bills they want,” he said. “I just go veto, veto, veto.”
“总统职位，我们这个总统职位，被认为是一个权力很大的职位。你可以做很多事情，”特朗普在选举之夜接受CBS新闻采访时说。当时，共和党在全国各地遭到选民否定，他们将国会参众两院的控制权交给民主党。周四在深圳举行会晤之前，特朗普接受福克斯新闻采访时强调，他将对抗新一届国会。“他们想通过多少法案都行，”他说。“我只管否决、否决、否决。”
众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯是民主党在众议院的领袖。特朗普很快就不得不在华盛顿与重新掌控国会的民主党人分享权力。

Unpopular presidents who lose control of Congress often turn to international affairs where they have more latitude to operate. Mr. Trump did not need congressional approval to meet with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. But with his Iran war stalled after nine months, Mr. Trump has less room to maneuver. And foreign leaders understand that he is now a lame duck who will be out of office in just over two years.
不受欢迎的总统一旦失去对国会的控制，往往会转向国际事务，因为在那里他们拥有更大的行动自由度。特朗普不需要国会批准就能会晤习近平和普京。但由于他的伊朗战争在九个月后陷入停滞，特朗普的回旋余地更小了。外国领导人也明白，他现在是一个跛脚鸭总统，再过两年多就会卸任。

But the summit offered a welcome respite to Mr. Trump, who has long expressed admiration for authoritarian leaders like Mr. Putin and Mr. Xi, often applying the word “strong” to them, perhaps his favorite compliment. He has over the years talked enviously of their ability to get things done unburdened by the messy obstacles of legislatures and courts.
不过，对特朗普来说，这场峰会无疑是一次求之不得的喘息机会。长期以来，他一直对普京和习近平这样的威权领导人表示钦佩，经常用“强大”来形容他们，这或许是他最喜欢的赞美之词。多年来，他曾不无羡慕地谈到，这些领导人不必受到立法机关和法院种种繁琐掣肘，就能把事情办成。

Indeed, Mr. Putin later suggested that he and Mr. Trump shared a common view of “civilizational values” and a “certain closeness” in perspectives. “For instance,” Mr. Putin told reporters after the meeting, “we were just discussing issues of democracy, right? But what is democracy, really?” He went on to suggest that “is, in fact, a liberal attempt to monopolize power — a liberal dictatorship, if you will.”
事实上，普京后来表示，他与特朗普对“文明价值观”有着共同理解，在其他问题上的看法也有“一定的相通之处”。普京在会后对记者说，“比如，我们刚才还在讨论民主问题，对吧？但民主究竟是什么？”他接着说，民主“实际上是自由派试图垄断权力的一种方式——可以说是一种自由派独裁”。

In his second term, Mr. Trump has endeavored to assert executive power to a far greater degree than in his first, asserting authority to sidestep Congress and the courts. He has taken an expansive view of his office, using the Justice Department to prosecute his personal enemies, gutting congressionally authorized agencies, firing theoretically independent officials and so on.
在第二任期内，特朗普一直试图以前所未有的力度扩张行政权力，宣称自己有权绕过国会和法院行事。他对总统职权采取了极为宽泛的解释，包括利用司法部起诉自己的私敌、大幅削弱经国会授权设立的机构、解雇理论上应保持独立的官员，等等。

Asked in an interview with The New York Times in January whether he acknowledged any limits to his global power, he said: “Yeah, there is one thing. My own morality. My own mind. It’s the only thing that can stop me.”
今年1月接受《纽约时报》采访时，他被问及是否承认自己的全球权力存在任何限制，他说：“有，只有一样东西——我自己的道德，我自己的判断。这是唯一能阻止我的东西。”

Last month, he mused out loud to reporters in the Oval Office about how he could have used his power to go after Democrats like former Presidents Joseph R. Biden Jr. and Barack Obama and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, but chose not to. “I can do whatever I want, if I want,” he said.
上个月，特朗普在椭圆形办公室向记者谈起，自己本来可以利用权力追究前总统拜登、奥巴马以及前国务卿希拉里等民主党人，但最终选择没有这么做。“只要我愿意，我想做什么都可以，”他说。

Mr. Trump’s view of power goes back to his days in business. As a family-owned firm, the Trump Organization had no board of directors or shareholders to whom Mr. Trump had to answer. His decisions essentially were the final word. After he was inaugurated for his first term in 2017, he expressed shock that the government did not operate the same way.
特朗普的权力观可以追溯到他的经商岁月。作为一家家族企业，特朗普集团没有董事会或股东需要他来负责。他的决定基本上就是最终决定。2017年首次宣誓就任总统后，他曾对政府不能以同样方式运作感到震惊。
He has surrounded himself with advisers who share his view of power, and his choice of chief of staff after his party’s disastrous midterm results made clear that he has no intention of backing down.
他在身边安排了一批与自己持有相同权力观的顾问。共和党在中期选举中惨败后，他对新任白宫办公厅主任的选择表明，他丝毫没有退让的打算。
尽管选民在中期选举中明确表达了对他的否定，特朗普仍试图通过任命信奉“强权即公理”的斯蒂芬·米勒为新任白宫办公厅主任，重新确立自己的权威。

Stephen Miller, the new chief, has long voiced maximalist ideas about executive power. As a policy aide in the first Trump administration, Mr. Miller responded to a judge’s ruling striking down a ban on people from predominantly Muslim countries by saying that “the powers of the president to protect our country are very substantial and will not be questioned.”
新任办公厅主任斯蒂芬·米勒长期以来一直主张最大限度地扩大行政权力。在特朗普第一届政府担任政策顾问期间，一名法官曾推翻针对多个穆斯林人口占多数国家的入境禁令。米勒对此回应说：“总统保护我们国家的权力非常广泛，不容质疑。”

Secretary of State Marco Rubio reflected the administration’s view about the reach of its authority during a recent speech to the Federalist Society denouncing the International Criminal Court, an institution that the United States has never joined but has become a particular target of Mr. Trump lately. Among other things, the court has issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin for alleged war crimes stemming from his invasion of Ukraine.
国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥最近在联邦党人学会发表演讲，抨击国际刑事法院，反映出特朗普政府对自身权力范围的看法。美国从未加入该法院，但最近它已成为特朗普特别针对的目标。该法院曾因普京入侵乌克兰所涉战争罪指控，对普京发出了逮捕令。

“If they’re foolish enough to try to enforce their paper decrees on Americans,” Mr. Rubio said of the international court, “our answer will probably be the same as the Roman general Pompey when he said to those who were trying to invoke their cities’ charters against his legions. He said, ‘Stop quoting laws to men with swords.’”
“如果他们愚蠢到试图对美国人执行他们的一纸法令，”鲁比奥谈到该国际法院时说，“我们的回答大概会像罗马将军庞培那样。他对那些试图援引自己城市的特许状来对抗他军团的人说：‘别向持剑之人引用法律。’”
“Not politically correct to say that,” he added, “but that’s what he said. That’s what he said.”
“这么说政治不正确，”他补充道，“但他当时就是这么说的。就是这么说的。”
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth liked the idea so much that he posted a clip of Mr. Rubio online along with the line: “Stop quoting laws to MEN WITH SWORDS.”
国防部长皮特·海格塞斯非常喜欢这个说法，以至于把鲁比奥的这段视频发到网上，并附上了那句话：“别向持剑之人引用法律。”

Mr. Hegseth’s post generated criticism even from fellow conservatives who oppose American recognition of the International Criminal Court. Former Representative Justin Amash of Michigan, who left the Republican Party, called it an abandonment of the rule of law.
海格塞斯的帖子甚至招致了同样反对美国承认国际刑事法院的保守派人士的批评。已退出共和党的密歇根州前众议员贾斯廷·阿马什认为，这种说法背弃了法治原则。

“Rejecting the ICC’s jurisdiction is one thing,” he wrote online. “Declaring that laws become irrelevant the moment swords appear is another. That’s just ‘might makes right,’ which is a fundamental rejection of both Christian ethics and America’s founding.”
“拒绝承认国际刑事法院的管辖权是一回事，”他在网上写道。“宣称刀剑一出现，法律就不再重要，则是另一回事。这无非就是‘强权即公理’，从根本上否定了基督教伦理和美国的立国原则。

In Shenzhen, Mr. Trump, Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin made clear where they stood on the idea of the reach of international law. In the joint statement they released afterward, they said that immunity of state officials is “of paramount importance.” On that, at least, the leaders of America, China and Russia were on the same page.
在深圳，特朗普、习近平和普京明确表明了他们对国际法适用范围的立场。在随后发表的联合声明中，三人表示，国家官员的豁免权“至关重要”。至少在这一点上，美中俄三国领导人达成了一致。
Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。

items.body:
ANA SWANSON, CECILIA KANG2026年11月20日

Lawmakers released confidential information on Thursday showing that the Commerce Department had approved the sale of more than 800,000 advanced A.I. chips to Chinese companies for the year, as of May 11, including several firms on a list of Chinese military companies maintained by the Pentagon.

立法者周四发布了机密信息，显示截至5月11日，美国商务部今年已批准向中国企业出售超过80万枚先进人工智能芯片，其中包括几家被五角大楼列入中国涉军企业名单的公司。

The department had received applications to sell more than 3.4 million of the chips to Chinese companies as of that date, lawmakers said. It approved 75,000 artificial intelligence chips for Alibaba, a Chinese A.I. giant that The New York Times reported this week has ties with a military-linked laboratory.

立法者表示，商务部截至该日期收到向中国企业出售超过340万枚此类芯片的申请。该部批准向阿里巴巴出售7.5万枚人工智能芯片，阿里巴巴是一家中国人工智能巨头，《纽约时报》本周报道称其与一家具有军方背景的实验室有联系。

The release also showed that Nvidia had submitted an application in April to sell more than 40,000 of its advanced H200 chips to a company tied to Megaspeed and Alice Huang, the executive who U.S. intelligence has concluded was a Chinese asset who had an affair with the former Nvidia chief executive.

此次发布的信息还显示，英伟达曾在4月份提交申请，计划将其超过4万枚先进的H200芯片出售给一家与Megaspeed及其高管黄乐(Alice Huang)有联系的公司。美国情报部门已得出结论，认定黄乐是一名与前英伟达首席执行官有染的中国情报线人。

The company — New Century Lettall Data Service — is part of a network of Chinese companies with ties to Megaspeed and Ms. Huang. Its historical ownership traces back in part to an investment firm controlled by Ms. Huang’s sister, where Kang Wei, whom Ms. Huang often introduced as her husband, was also executive director.

这家名为新世纪利通数据服务有限公司的公司是与Megaspeed和黄乐有联系的中国企业网络的一部分。其历史所有权部分可追溯至由黄乐的姐姐控制的一家投资公司，而康伟（黄乐经常将其介绍为她的丈夫）也曾是该公司的执行董事。

The Commerce Department also approved 150,000 chips for the Chinese tech conglomerate Tencent and its subsidiaries; 43,000 for Baidu, another Chinese A.I. firm; and 4,000 for BYD, a carmaker, the lawmakers said. They were Nvidia’s H200 chips and the equivalent from the chip maker AMD, the MI325X.

立法者表示，商务部还批准向中国科技集团腾讯及其子公司出售15万枚芯片；向另一家中国人工智能公司百度出售4.3万枚；向汽车制造商比亚迪出售4000枚。这些芯片是英伟达的H200芯片以及芯片制造商AMD的同级别产品MI325X。

《纽约时报》记者走访了至索和新矩阵在中国的办公室，发现两处均空无一人。

The lawmakers, from the House Foreign Affairs Committee, took special note of the Commerce Department’s approval of sales to the companies Maginfra, Beijing New Matrix Information Technologies and Aivres Systems. The committee cited reporting by The New York Times that had raised questions about those firms because of their ties to sanctioned entities and noted that many of the license requests from Nvidia had listed the companies as entities that might install the systems in data centers.

来自众议院外交事务委员会的立法者特别关注了商务部批准向至索(Maginfra)、北京新矩阵信息技术有限公司(Beijing New Matrix Information Technologies)以及Aivres Systems出售芯片的决定。该委员会引用了《纽约时报》的报道，该报道曾因这些公司与受制裁实体的联系而对其提出质疑，委员会还指出，英伟达的许多许可申请都将这些公司列为可能在数据中心安装这些系统的实体。

Two Times reports first raised concerns about the firms in September and October, saying that Aivres was the subsidiary of a sanctioned Chinese firm that had exported billions of dollars of advanced Nvidia chips to Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Nvidia scandal.

《纽约时报》分别在9月和10月的两份报道中首先提出对这些公司的关切，称Aivres是一家受制裁中国企业的子公司，该受制裁企业已向处于英伟达丑闻中心的Megaspeed公司出口了价值数十亿美元的先进英伟达芯片。

Times reporters also visited the China offices of Maginfra and New Matrix and found them to be empty. No one present had heard of the firms, and scant information existed about them online, raising questions about whether they really existed.

《纽约时报》记者还走访了至索和新矩阵的中国办公室，发现里面空无一人。在场的人都没有听说过这些公司，网上关于它们的信息也寥寥无几，这引发了关于它们是否真实存在的疑问。

The revelations that Nvidia’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, was having an affair with Ms. Huang, along with a second woman at Nvidia, forced him to step down last week. The Justice and Commerce Departments said this week that Megaspeed was under criminal investigation for potentially smuggling chips into China.

由于与黄乐以及英伟达内部另一名女性有染的事件曝光，黄仁勋被迫于上周辞职。美国司法部和商务部本周表示，Megaspeed正因涉嫌向中国走私芯片而接受刑事调查。

The incident has sparked criticism from lawmakers that the Trump administration, and the Commerce Department in particular, did too little to police the flow of sensitive technology to China. Officials both in the administration and on Capitol Hill have criticized the department for maintaining close ties to Nvidia, which it is charged with regulating.

这起事件引发了国会议员的批评，他们认为特朗普政府，尤其是商务部，在监管敏感技术流向中国方面做得远远不够。政府内部和国会的官员都批评商务部与英伟达保持密切关系，尽管该部门负有监管英伟达的职责。

众议员布赖恩·马斯特称至索和新矩阵为“假公司”，并表示，如果商务部批准了这些公司的申请，“显然，这会让我们极为担忧。”

The Commerce Department has defended its processes, saying that it closely follows national security regulations. Every Nvidia and AMD application also stated that the proposed transfer posed a low risk of diversion, the committee’s release said.

商务部为其审批流程进行了辩护，称其严格遵守了国家安全规定。委员会发布的信息称，英伟达和AMD提交的每一份申请均声称，拟议中的芯片转让发生违规转移的风险很低。

John Rizzo, a spokesman for Nvidia, said that all of the company’s shipments were legal and authorized by the government, and that, despite receiving some licenses, Nvidia had already stopped shipping H200s to China. Nvidia “did not and will not” ship an H200 to the company linked to Megaspeed, or any other company, he said.

英伟达发言人约翰·里佐表示，该公司的所有芯片出货都是合法的，并获得政府授权。尽管已获得部分许可证，英伟达此前就已停止向中国发货H200芯片。他说，英伟达“过去没有、将来也不会”向与Megaspeed有关联的那家公司或任何其他公司运送H200芯片。

A spokeswoman for AMD said the company complied with applicable U.S. laws and regulations and had a rigorous process to ensure compliance.

AMD发言人表示，该公司遵守所有适用的美国法律法规，并建立了严格的合规审查程序。

A spokesman for the Commerce Department said the disclosure was evidence of the department’s transparency with Congress about licensing activity. Licensing decisions are the product of deliberation and consultation among multiple U.S. government agencies, he said.

商务部的发言人表示，此次信息披露证明了该部门在许可证审批方面对国会保持透明。他表示，许可证审批决定是美国政府多个机构审议和协商的结果。

President Trump approved the sale of the H200 to China in December under unusual conditions. He required the chips, which are assembled in Taiwan, to be routed through the United States on their way to China, so that the government could collect a 25 percent tariff on their value and perform a security check.

去年12月，特朗普总统批准向中国出售H200芯片，但附加了非同寻常的条件。他要求这些在台湾组装的芯片在运往中国途中必须先经过美国，以便美国政府按芯片价值征收25%的关税，并进行安全检查。

Wary of the arrangement and eager to promote its own technology, the Chinese government ended up approving few purchases from its firms.

中国政府对这一安排心存疑虑，同时又希望扶持本国技术，因此最终只批准了国内企业的少量采购申请。

Nvidia said in its earnings this week that it would halt sales of its H200 chips to China, though it did not give a reason for the move.

英伟达在本周的财报中表示，将停止向中国出售其H200芯片，不过并未给出此举的理由。

In its statement, the House Foreign Affairs Committee said that withholding the information was “contrary to the national interest.” The committee plans to hold hearings next month with both Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, and his deputy Jeff Kessler, who has had a special role in approving license applications.

立法者周四发布了机密信息，显示截至5月11日，美国商务部今年已批准向中国企业出售超过80万枚先进人工智能芯片，其中包括几家被五角大楼列入中国涉军企业名单的公司。

The department had received applications to sell more than 3.4 million of the chips to Chinese companies as of that date, lawmakers said. It approved 75,000 artificial intelligence chips for Alibaba, a Chinese A.I. giant that The New York Times reported this week has ties with a military-linked laboratory.
立法者表示，商务部截至该日期收到向中国企业出售超过340万枚此类芯片的申请。该部批准向阿里巴巴出售7.5万枚人工智能芯片，阿里巴巴是一家中国人工智能巨头，《纽约时报》本周报道称其与一家具有军方背景的实验室有联系。

The release also showed that Nvidia had submitted an application in April to sell more than 40,000 of its advanced H200 chips to a company tied to Megaspeed and Alice Huang, the executive who U.S. intelligence has concluded was a Chinese asset who had an affair with the former Nvidia chief executive.
此次发布的信息还显示，英伟达曾在4月份提交申请，计划将其超过4万枚先进的H200芯片出售给一家与Megaspeed及其高管黄乐(Alice Huang)有联系的公司。美国情报部门已得出结论，认定黄乐是一名与前英伟达首席执行官有染的中国情报线人。

The company — New Century Lettall Data Service — is part of a network of Chinese companies with ties to Megaspeed and Ms. Huang. Its historical ownership traces back in part to an investment firm controlled by Ms. Huang’s sister, where Kang Wei, whom Ms. Huang often introduced as her husband, was also executive director.
这家名为新世纪利通数据服务有限公司的公司是与Megaspeed和黄乐有联系的中国企业网络的一部分。其历史所有权部分可追溯至由黄乐的姐姐控制的一家投资公司，而康伟（黄乐经常将其介绍为她的丈夫）也曾是该公司的执行董事。

The Commerce Department also approved 150,000 chips for the Chinese tech conglomerate Tencent and its subsidiaries; 43,000 for Baidu, another Chinese A.I. firm; and 4,000 for BYD, a carmaker, the lawmakers said. They were Nvidia’s H200 chips and the equivalent from the chip maker AMD, the MI325X.
立法者表示，商务部还批准向中国科技集团腾讯及其子公司出售15万枚芯片；向另一家中国人工智能公司百度出售4.3万枚；向汽车制造商比亚迪出售4000枚。这些芯片是英伟达的H200芯片以及芯片制造商AMD的同级别产品MI325X。

The incident has sparked criticism from lawmakers that the Trump administration, and the Commerce Department in particular, did too little to police the flow of sensitive technology to China. Officials both in the administration and on Capitol Hill have criticized the department for maintaining close ties to Nvidia, which it is charged with regulating.
这起事件引发了国会议员的批评，他们认为特朗普政府，尤其是商务部，在监管敏感技术流向中国方面做得远远不够。政府内部和国会的官员都批评商务部与英伟达保持密切关系，尽管该部门负有监管英伟达的职责。
众议员布赖恩·马斯特称至索和新矩阵为“假公司”，并表示，如果商务部批准了这些公司的申请，“显然，这会让我们极为担忧。”

AMD发言人表示，该公司遵守所有适用的美国法律法规，并建立了严格的合规审查程序。

A spokesman for the Commerce Department said the disclosure was evidence of the department’s transparency with Congress about licensing activity. Licensing decisions are the product of deliberation and consultation among multiple U.S. government agencies, he said.

Wary of the arrangement and eager to promote its own technology, the Chinese government ended up approving few purchases from its firms.

北京电影学院设立马克思主义学院

中国知名院校北京电影学院本周成立马克思主义学院。北京电影学院强调，把马克思主义的旗帜在艺术教育的阵地上高高举起。

北京电影学院在微信公众号公布，北京电影学院马克思主义学院在星期三（11月18日）正式成立，并说：“从延安电影团一路走来，北京电影学院始终坚守立德树人初心使命，为党育人、为国育才，把马克思主义的旗帜，在艺术教育的阵地上高高举起！”

中共北京市委教育工委副书记张宇蕾，北京市社科联党组成员、副主席、市社科规划办副主任许星，北京电影学院校友、导演肖桂云，演员宋晓英，北京电影学院党委书记张健，党委副书记、院长扈强，校领导童雷、李伟、潘若简、蒋晓辉出席成立大会。

张宇蕾在讲话中说，马克思主义学院的成立是学校加强党的全面领导、落实立德树人根本任务、推动高质量发展的重要举措。她希望学校强化党的全面领导，筑牢马院建设政治保障；聚焦铸魂育人根本，打造艺术院校马克思主义理论研究高地；坚守以人民为中心创作立场，培育德艺双馨文艺新人。

扈强则在大会上介绍了《北京电影学院马克思主义学院高质量发展工作方案》。据北京电影学院介绍，方案围绕坚持政治引领、突出影视特色、加强理论和实践研究、坚持服务社会、加强人才队伍建设、加强学院治理六个方面作出系统部署，明确分“夯实基础、提质攻坚、创优提升”三个阶段推进建设，力争建成特色鲜明、办学过硬的马克思主义学院，形成示范建设经验。

成立大会后，中国国防科技大学思政课指导教师朱容瑢主讲马克思主义学院“第一堂课”。北京电影学院说，朱容瑢“结合祖母朱枫烈士在隐蔽战线上的革命事迹，讲述红色家风传承与信仰力量，以真实的历史细节和深情的讲述，为在场师生呈现了一堂具有特殊感染力的思政课”。

阿里巴巴因隐瞒与黄仁勋外遇对象有业务关系被股东起诉

中国电商巨头阿里巴巴因隐瞒与黄仁勋外遇对象有业务关系被股东起诉。

据路透社报道，阿里巴巴集团因隐瞒与美国科技巨企英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋有私情的疑似中国女间谍有业务关系，而欺诈投资者，星期四（11月19日）在纽约被股东起诉。黄仁勋因与上述女子有染，在上周辞职。

根据股东向曼哈顿联邦法院提交的拟议集体诉讼书，阿里巴巴在2024年、2025年和2026年的年度报告中，故意且实质性地低估了实际或涉嫌违反出口管制规定对公司业务造成损害的风险，借此人为推高了公司股价。

股东在诉状中引述了阿里巴巴与一家新加坡公司超速国际的关系，称超速国际涉嫌协助北京获取英伟达人工智能（AI）晶片，而超速国际高管黄乐（Alice Huang）曾与黄仁勋保持着私人关系。

股东称，受报道指阿里巴巴与黄乐及超速国际存在关联，包括指阿里巴巴已成为超速国际“主要”客户等内容影响，阿里巴巴股价上周在四个交易日内下跌了14%。

items.body:
艾莎2026年11月20日

随着华盛顿和北京在人工智能领域争夺霸权，双方都在为其本土技术划定红线。 Tingshu Wang/Reuters

It was the biggest initial public offering in history and investors from China and Hong Kong were left out.

这是史上最大的首次公开募股，而来自中国和香港的投资者被排除在外。

Anthropic, the artificial intelligence company and maker of the Claude chatbot, excluded investment from Chinese and Hong Kong firms from buying its shares in advance of the I.P.O., according to three people with knowledge of the decision, who asked not to be identified because they were not authorized to speak publicly.

据三位了解该决定的人士透露，在IPO之前，人工智能公司、Claude聊天机器人的制造商Anthropic排除了中国和香港机构的购股资格。由于未获授权公开发表言论，这三位人士要求不具名。

A representative for Anthropic declined to comment, and the reason for not accepting investments from the region was not clear. But it follows a move by the Trump administration to keep artificial intelligence out of China’s reach. Both Washington and Beijing are drawing red lines around their homegrown technology as they compete for supremacy in A.I.

Anthropic的一名代表拒绝置评，而不接受该地区投资的原因至今尚未明确。但此举紧随特朗普政府的一项旨在防止中国获取人工智能技术的措施之后。随着华盛顿和北京在人工智能领域争夺霸权，双方都在为其本土技术划定红线。

It also follows a similar move by SpaceX and its bankers to shut out China from its blockbuster public offering. OpenAI, another leading A.I. company, is expected to bar Chinese investors from its eventual public offering. OpenAI has already barred Chinese investors from participating in private fund-raising. All three companies have counted the U.S. government as a client.

此前SpaceX及其银行家也采取了类似举措，即在其轰动一时的公开募股中将中国拒之门外。另一家领先的人工智能公司OpenAI最终进行IPO时，也将禁止中国投资者参与。OpenAI已经禁止了中国投资者参与私募融资。这三家公司都与美国政府有业务往来。

The news that Anthropic would bar Chinese investors was reported earlier by Bloomberg.

Anthropic将禁止中国投资者的消息早前由彭博社报道。

President Trump and China’s leader, Xi Jinping, met on Thursday at the APEC meeting in the Chinese city of Shenzhen, where Mr. Xi called on members to build an “open ecosystem” for technology.

周四，特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平在中国城市深圳举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)会议上会晤，习近平在会上呼吁成员国构建技术的“开放创新生态”。

Both Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi are trying to inject some stability — and a little bonhomie — into an increasingly rocky economic relationship between the world’s two biggest economies. But their governments continue to build fortresses around trade, technology and capital.

特朗普和习近平都试图为这两个世界最大经济体之间日益动荡的经济关系注入一些稳定性——以及一丝友好气氛。但两国政府继续围绕贸易、技术和资本构筑堡垒。

Hours before Mr. Trump arrived in Asia to attend meetings with regional leaders, his administration moved to restrict China’s access to advanced artificial intelligence chips. In response, China warned it could hit back, saying “if the U.S. persists, China will take countermeasures.”

在特朗普抵达亚洲参加与地区领导人的会议前数小时，其政府采取行动限制中国获取先进人工智能芯片。对此，中国警告称可能会进行反击，表示“若美方一意孤行，中方将采取反制措施”。

“China is deeply concerned about — and firmly opposes — a series of recent economic and trade restrictive measures taken by the U.S. against China,” a spokesman for China’s Ministry of Commerce said on Thursday.

“中方对美方近期出台的一系列涉华经贸限制措施强烈关注，坚决反对，”中国商务部发言人周四表示。

China experts warned that the new A.I. rule, the latest in a series of escalatory moves from both sides, will make it harder for both Mr. Xi and Mr. Trump to come to any meaningful agreement to de-escalate rising conflict between the world’s biggest economies.

中国问题专家警告称，新的人工智能规定是双方一系列升级举措中的最新一项，这将使习近平和特朗普更难达成任何有意义的协议，以缓和这两个世界最大经济体之间日益加剧的冲突。

“At a minimum, this step — and potential others yet to come — complicate reaching a deal to extend the cease-fire,” said Scott Kennedy, researcher at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington.

“至少，这一举措——以及未来可能出台的其他举措——将给休战协议的延展制造困难，”华盛顿战略与国际问题研究中心研究员甘思德(Scott Kennedy)表示。

艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson)是《纽约时报》记者，主要报道中国经济及其在全球的影响。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

items.body:
KATIE ROGERS, DAVID E. SANGER2026年11月20日

周四，俄罗斯总统普京、中国国家主席习近平和特朗普总统在深圳举行三边会晤前合影。 Doug Mills/The New York Times

President Trump used his first-ever trilateral summit with Presidents Xi Jinping of China and Vladimir V. Putin of Russia on Thursday to say that their respective nations were “uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on earth.”

特朗普总统在周四与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行的首次三边峰会上表示，三国“处于独特的位置，可以讨论如何减少地球上的核武器数量”。

But after an 80-minute conversation at a lakeside villa in the city of Shenzhen, a Chinese technology hub, it was unclear whether the three leaders had agreed to return to the kind of arms control talks that for decades were a centerpiece of diplomacy among superpowers during the Cold War. On new threats, including artificial intelligence, the three leaders were largely silent.

但在中国科技中心深圳市的一栋湖畔别墅进行了80分钟的交谈后，目前尚不清楚这三位领导人是否已同意重返军控谈判——冷战期间，此类谈判在长达数十年内一直是超级大国之间外交的核心。对于包括人工智能在内的新威胁，这三位领导人基本上保持沉默。

Mr. Trump, who also met with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin separately at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum this week, appeared delighted to convene the world’s largest nuclear powers for a discussion about disarmament. But he did not come with a detailed plan for how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons, or outline a path to one.

特朗普本周还在亚太经济合作组织论坛上分别会见了习近平和普京，他似乎很高兴能召集世界上最大的核大国就裁军问题进行讨论。但他并没有带来关于如何减少核武器数量的详细计划，也没有概述实现这一目标的路径。

Instead, Mr. Trump relished what amounted to a high-profile photo opportunity of the three leaders seated around a circular wooden table. For Mr. Trump, the main achievement seemed to be a mutual commitment to keep talking about peace — without taking meaningful steps toward it.

相反，特朗普更乐于享受三位领导人围坐在圆形木桌旁的高调拍照机会。对特朗普来说，此次会议的主要成果似乎是各方承诺将继续就和平问题进行对话——却没有任何就此采取的实质性举措。

“Too often, past leaders avoided talking to nations with whom they had disagreements, and we feel the opposite.” Mr. Trump told Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. “No peace was ever forged by declining opportunities for engagement and speech.”

“过去的领导人往往避免与存在分歧的国家进行对话，而我们的感觉恰恰相反。”特朗普对习近平和普京说。“拒绝接触和对话的机会，从来都不能带来和平。”

After the summit, the leaders released a joint statement saying they had agreed to reform the United Nations, increase the production and supply of petroleum, oppose perceived abuses by the International Criminal Court against state officials, and continue their dialogue on reducing nuclear risks. “A nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought,” the statement said.

峰会结束后，三位领导人发表了一份联合声明，表示他们已同意就改革联合国，增加石油的生产和供应，反对国际刑事法院对国家官员的所谓滥用管辖权行为，并继续就降低核风险进行对话。“核战争打不赢也打不得，”声明称。

While China, which has the fastest-growing nuclear arsenal on earth, agreed to participate in the three-way discussion of nuclear weapons, the leaders announced little concrete beyond agreeing to continue a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks. Mr. Xi has long been reluctant to agree to nuclear arms control because China’s arsenal remains a fraction the size of those belonging to Russia and the United States.

中国核武库增长速度位居全球之首，尽管它同意参与关于核武器的三方讨论，但除了同意继续就降低核风险进行对话之外，领导人们几乎没有宣布任何具体内容。习近平长期以来一直不愿同意核军备控制，因为中国的核武库规模仍然只是俄罗斯和美国的一小部分。

In the end, Mr. Trump’s whirlwind journey — two weeks after the Republican Party suffered a wipeout in the midterm elections and amid anxiety at home about widespread digital outages — amounted to a grand show of camaraderie.

最终，特朗普的这次旋风式访问——在共和党于中期选举中惨败两周后，且国内正因大范围网络中断而焦虑之际——无非是一场展示情谊的盛大表演。

As host of the tightly choreographed event, Mr. Xi flattered Mr. Trump and gave him an opportunity to ask for China’s assistance on matters ranging from ending global conflicts to spending more on U.S. agricultural goods. The summit also removed Mr. Putin from his status a global pariah over his invasion of Ukraine, elevating him to a leader deserving of equal diplomatic footing.

作为这场精心策划的活动的东道主，习近平奉承特朗普，并给特朗普提供机会，在结束全球冲突和增加美国农产品采购等一系列问题上寻求中国的协助。这次峰会也使普京摆脱了因入侵乌克兰而成为全球弃儿的地位，将他提升为一位值得享有平等待遇的外交领导人。

But for all of the talk of peace, there was no announcement of breakthroughs in the talks the Trump administration is engaged in to end that conflict. Nor did Mr. Trump appear to dwell on finding a way out of the its war with Iran.

但是，尽管各方都在大谈和平，但关于特朗普政府为结束该冲突而进行的谈判并未宣布任何突破性进展。特朗普似乎也没有过多关注如何解决美国与伊朗之间的战争。

“We don’t need any help,” Mr. Trump said, when asked by a Fox News reporter before the summit whether he would seek assistance from the other leaders in ending a conflict of his own making. In fact, the help Mr. Trump could ask for would involve demanding that China and Russia stop assisting Iran: U.S. intelligence has concluded that both countries provided either technology or targeting information that likely helped the Iranians strike American military bases in the Middle East.

“我们不需要任何帮助，”特朗普在峰会前被福克斯新闻记者问及是否会寻求其他领导人协助，以结束这场由他自己造成的冲突时说道。事实上，特朗普若要寻求帮助，就必须要求中国和俄罗斯停止援助伊朗：美国情报部门已得出结论，这两个国家提供了技术或目标信息，这些信息可能帮助伊朗袭击了美国在中东的军事基地。

On Fox News, Mr. Trump described the three-way conversation as a way to disrupt the growing “partnership without limits” that Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin say they have formed in recent years. Mr. Trump said that he hoped to break up that alignment and turn it into a three-way conversation, rather than a partnership focused on countering American influence.

特朗普将这场三方对话描述为一种手段，旨在瓦解习近平和普京声称近年来建立的日益紧密的“无上限伙伴关系”。特朗普表示，他希望能打破这种结盟，并将其转变为三方对话，而不是一个专注于对抗美国影响力的伙伴关系。

China and Russia’s alignment, Mr. Trump said, “should have never been allowed to happen.”

特朗普说，中国和俄罗斯的结盟“本来就不应该被允许发生”。

特朗普对隆重的欢迎仪式赞叹不已，并将其视为两国关系日益密切的明证，他在接受采访时表示，抵达时“一位伟大的中国领导人”亲自迎接了他。

Seeking his own path into Mr. Xi’s good graces, Mr. Trump has held three meetings with the Chinese leader this year, with the goal of cooling a tit-for-tat trade war and of building up a personal relationship through mutual flattery. Mr. Trump traveled to Joint Base Andrews to welcome Mr. Xi to Washington in May, and Mr. Xi responded in kind when Mr. Trump arrived in Shenzhen on Wednesday, treating the president to a military exercise and a fleet of U.S. and Chinese flag-waving dancers in a flurry of pink, blue and white outfits.

为了寻求获得习近平的好感，特朗普今年已经与中国领导人举行了三次会晤，旨在缓和针锋相对的贸易战，并通过相互奉承建立个人关系。今年5月，特朗普专程前往安德鲁斯联合基地，欢迎习近平访问华盛顿；而当特朗普于周三抵达深圳时，习近平也做出了同样的回应，以军事演习招待总统，还安排了一支身穿粉色、蓝色和白色服装，挥舞中美两国国旗的舞蹈队表演。

Mr. Xi, for his part, said a much improved relationship between China and the United States in recent months was “the right way” for the two powers to “get along.” But he also warned that the key to keeping ties stable “lies in taking concrete actions to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state.” The remarks came days after Washington moved to close a loophole on Chinese access to advanced A.I. chips.

习近平则表示，近几个月来中美之间大为改善的关系是两个大国“相处”的“正确之道”。但他也警告说，保持双边关系稳定的关键是“在落实元首共识上付诸行动”。这些言论发表几天前，华盛顿刚刚采取行动，堵住了一个中国获取先进人工智能芯片的漏洞。

As for Mr. Putin, the summit was his first encounter with Mr. Trump since the two men met in Alaska last year. That meeting was a diplomatic flop, and the war in Ukraine has intensified since then. The peace mechanism Mr. Trump advocated — a direct meeting between Mr. Putin and President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine, moderated by Mr. Trump — has yet to materialize.

至于普京，这次峰会是自去年他与特朗普在阿拉斯加会面以来，二人首次重逢。那次会晤以外交失败告终，此后乌克兰战争愈演愈烈。特朗普所倡导的和平机制——由特朗普主持、普京与乌克兰总统泽连斯基直接会面——至今尚未实现。

This time, White House officials were modest in their predictions. Expectations were set so low that White House officials who previewed the trip last week initially said that Mr. Trump would not bring up the war in Ukraine at all, although he ultimately did.

这一次，白宫官员对此次会晤的预期相当低调。预期被设定得如此之低，以至于上周预告此次行程的白宫官员起初表示，特朗普根本不会提及乌克兰战争，尽管他最终还是提了。

In Shenzhen, Mr. Trump continued welcoming Russia back into the fold of great superpowers. He called Mr. Putin “my friend,” and insisted that all three leaders would like to see the war end quickly. The Russian leader reiterated after the meeting, however, that he would not be negotiating with Ukraine.

在深圳，特朗普继续欢迎俄罗斯重返超级大国行列。他称普京为“我的朋友”，并坚称三位领导人都希望看到战争尽快结束。然而，俄罗斯领导人在会后重申，他不会与乌克兰进行谈判。

During the trilateral meeting, Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin embraced the idea of peaceful leadership, without making commitments that would be much of a burden to either of their countries. In his own remarks, Mr. Putin said that their nations were “united not only by the status of being the victorious countries in World War II, but most importantly by the joint responsibility for maintaining international peace and security.”

在这次三边会议期间，习近平和普京赞同和平领导的理念，而没有做出会对中俄两国造成沉重负担的承诺。普京在自己的讲话中表示，中俄两国“不仅因为二战战胜国的地位而团结在一起，最重要的是因维护国际和平与安全的共同责任而团结在一起”。

And Mr. Xi mentioned a utopian goal that has pretty much fallen off the agenda of superpowers. He described nuclear weapons as a “sword of Damocles hanging over humanity” that should be eliminated. But Beijing has typically called on the United States to take the first steps in arms control, a demand that Mr. Trump seemed to acknowledge earlier in the day.

President Trump used his first-ever trilateral summit with Presidents Xi Jinping of China and Vladimir V. Putin of Russia on Thursday to say that their respective nations were “uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on earth.”
特朗普总统在周四与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行的首次三边峰会上表示，三国“处于独特的位置，可以讨论如何减少地球上的核武器数量”。

But after an 80-minute conversation at a lakeside villa in the city of Shenzhen, a Chinese technology hub, it was unclear whether the three leaders had agreed to return to the kind of arms control talks that for decades were a centerpiece of diplomacy among superpowers during the Cold War. On new threats, including artificial intelligence, the three leaders were largely silent.
但在中国科技中心深圳市的一栋湖畔别墅进行了80分钟的交谈后，目前尚不清楚这三位领导人是否已同意重返军控谈判——冷战期间，此类谈判在长达数十年内一直是超级大国之间外交的核心。对于包括人工智能在内的新威胁，这三位领导人基本上保持沉默。

Mr. Trump, who also met with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin separately at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum this week, appeared delighted to convene the world’s largest nuclear powers for a discussion about disarmament. But he did not come with a detailed plan for how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons, or outline a path to one.
特朗普本周还在亚太经济合作组织论坛上分别会见了习近平和普京，他似乎很高兴能召集世界上最大的核大国就裁军问题进行讨论。但他并没有带来关于如何减少核武器数量的详细计划，也没有概述实现这一目标的路径。

Instead, Mr. Trump relished what amounted to a high-profile photo opportunity of the three leaders seated around a circular wooden table. For Mr. Trump, the main achievement seemed to be a mutual commitment to keep talking about peace — without taking meaningful steps toward it.
相反，特朗普更乐于享受三位领导人围坐在圆形木桌旁的高调拍照机会。对特朗普来说，此次会议的主要成果似乎是各方承诺将继续就和平问题进行对话——却没有任何就此采取的实质性举措。

峰会结束后，三位领导人发表了一份联合声明，表示他们已同意就改革联合国，增加石油的生产和供应，反对国际刑事法院对国家官员的所谓滥用管辖权行为，并继续就降低核风险进行对话。“核战争打不赢也打不得，”声明称。

最终，特朗普的这次旋风式访问——在共和党于中期选举中惨败两周后，且国内正因大范围网络中断而焦虑之际——无非是一场展示情谊的盛大表演。

As host of the tightly choreographed event, Mr. Xi flattered Mr. Trump and gave him an opportunity to ask for China’s assistance on matters ranging from ending global conflicts to spending more on U.S. agricultural goods. The summit also removed Mr. Putin from his status a global pariah over his invasion of Ukraine, elevating him to a leader deserving of equal diplomatic footing.
作为这场精心策划的活动的东道主，习近平奉承特朗普，并给特朗普提供机会，在结束全球冲突和增加美国农产品采购等一系列问题上寻求中国的协助。这次峰会也使普京摆脱了因入侵乌克兰而成为全球弃儿的地位，将他提升为一位值得享有平等待遇的外交领导人。

But for all of the talk of peace, there was no announcement of breakthroughs in the talks the Trump administration is engaged in to end that conflict. Nor did Mr. Trump appear to dwell on finding a way out of the its war with Iran.
但是，尽管各方都在大谈和平，但关于特朗普政府为结束该冲突而进行的谈判并未宣布任何突破性进展。特朗普似乎也没有过多关注如何解决美国与伊朗之间的战争。

The Russian leader reiterated after the meeting, however, that he would not be negotiating with Ukraine.

继菲律宾之后造访中国深圳的日本首相高市早苗，于日本时间11月19日15时过后在当地举行了记者会。

items.body:
黄安伟2026年11月20日

周四，俄罗斯总统普京、中国领导人习近平与特朗普总统在深圳举行了三国领导人的首次正式三边会晤。 Doug Mills/The New York Times

At the end of a visit to Moscow more than three years ago, Xi Jinping, the leader of China, uttered a line to President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia that has come to define the outlook and actions of the two leaders.

三年多前，在访问莫斯科之行的最后，中国领导人习近平对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京说了一句话。如今这句话已成为两位领导人观念与行动的根本定义。

“Right now there are changes, the likes of which we haven’t seen for 100 years, and we are the ones driving these changes together,” he said.

他说：“这是百年变局的一部分，我们共同来推动。”

What Mr. Xi meant is this: The two men and their nations are transforming the world order by usurping the role of America as the sole superpower, the undisputed victor of the Cold War.

习近平的意思是：两位领导人及其国家正在通过终结美国作为唯一超级大国、冷战无可争议的胜利者的地位来重塑世界秩序。

Both Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin share a sense of historical grievance shaped by the expansion and dominance of U.S. power in the more than three decades since the fall of the Soviet Union. But from Mr. Xi’s perspective, that situation is evolving, and, rightly or wrongly, he has embraced a vision of America in terminal decline.

习近平和普京都怀着一种历史层面上的怨恨，这是由苏联解体三十多年来美国权力的扩张与主导所塑造的。但从习近平的角度来看，这种情况正在演变，而且他已经接受了美国正处于不可逆转的衰落的观点，无论这个观点是对还是错。

Mr. Xi brazenly used a similar line about historical changes in his opening remarks at a summit with Mr. Putin and President Trump on Thursday. “A transformation not seen in a century is accelerating,” he said at the conclave in Shenzhen, China.

R. Nicholas Burns, the ambassador to China in the Biden administration and a former ambassador to NATO, said that he never got any sense of ambivalence from Chinese officials on their support for Russia throughout the war, even though they would insist they were neutral in the conflict.

拜登政府驻华大使、前驻北约大使R·尼古拉斯·伯恩斯表示，尽管中国官员坚称在冲突中保持中立，但在整个战争期间，他从未感到他们在对俄罗斯的支持上有任何含糊。

但在两年后，特朗普可能将从世界舞台上消失，而普京和习近平可能会作为他们国家的领导人——且在他们自己眼中是伟人——再次共进晚餐。
黄安伟(Edward Wong)为《纽约时报》报道全球事务、美国外交政策和国务院新闻。

中俄美元首和平宣言

中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京、美国总统特朗普于2026年11月19日在深圳举行会晤。俄美领导人感谢中方主办此次历史性会晤。三国元首就当前国际形势深入交换了意见，致力于维护战略稳定和国际安全。

一、中国、俄罗斯、美国作为联合国安理会常任理事国，致力于推动联合国改革，使之更有效应对全球性挑战，并履行其维护国际和平与安全的基本使命。

二、三国计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应，以造福世界各国。三国重申能源稳定流动的重要性。

三、三国元首认可国家同意原则和尊重国家官员享有豁免至关重要，一致认为国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权。

快讯：中国取消限韩令

韩国文化体育观光部宣布：“向韩国民众通报一个振奋人心的好消息。

11月18日，在APEC领导人会议期间举行的中韩首脑会谈上，双方宣布《中韩自贸协定服务贸易与投资后续谈判》实质性结束。这距离2018年3月启动谈判，已过去约8年8个月。

通过此次谈判，中方承诺在电影、游戏等领域给予韩方不低于第三国的待遇，即“最惠国待遇”。在程序方面，双方也同意对网络游戏、电影等内容的事前审查适用非歧视原则。此外，两国还就视听节目联合制作附件达成一致。因此，原协定中仅限于电影的联合制作范围，扩大至电视剧、动画、综艺节目和纪录片等。

在旅游领域，双方将一项承诺纳入协定：在中国23个地区设立的韩国旅行社，可面向居住在中国的中国公民和外国人经营出境旅游业务。由此，为韩国旅行社直接招徕中国团体游客、直接销售个人旅游产品奠定了制度基础。

政府将继续与中方开展工作层面的磋商，以最终确定协定文本，并将加快推进正式签署和生效的后续程序。”

items.summary: 中国军方对英伟达芯片触手可及？阿里巴巴扮演重要角色 Telegraph | 原文链接 | 频道大全
items.body:
孟建国, ADAM SATARIANO2026年11月19日

阿里巴巴是一家业务广泛的互联网巨头。 Qilai Shen for The New York Times

In 2023, as the artificial intelligence boom took off, Alice Huang and her husband, Kang Wei, were pitching investors in Shanghai on a plan to build an A.I. business in Southeast Asia.

2023年，随着人工智能热潮兴起，黄乐(Alice Huang)和丈夫康伟在上海向投资者推介一项在东南亚建立人工智能业务的计划。

Working from a colonial mansion in the city’s former French Concession neighborhood, the couple boasted about Ms. Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang, then Nvidia’s chief executive, who they said would guarantee a supply of powerful computer chips.

两人在上海原法租界的一栋殖民时期洋房里办公，向投资者炫耀黄乐与时任英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的关系，声称黄仁勋能够保证向他们供应高性能计算机芯片。

They also hinted at a deep-pocketed customer that would pay for access to those chips and anchor the business, according to two people who attended the meetings. The company created after those pitch sessions, a Singapore firm called Megaspeed, purchased more than $4 billion in Nvidia chips over the next few years.

据两名参加了会议的人士说，他们还暗示有一位财力雄厚的客户将支付获取这些芯片的费用，并支撑这项业务。推介会结束后成立的新加坡公司Megaspeed在随后几年里购买了价值超过40亿美元的英伟达芯片。

Megaspeed’s customer and financial backer turned out to be Alibaba, the Chinese internet giant, according to three people familiar with the relationship. Alibaba is a colossus, with a wide range of businesses. It also co-founded an A.I. lab with strong ties to China’s military, where researchers have worked on tasks such as automating cyberattacks and simulating war games.

据三名知情人士指出，Megaspeed的客户和财务支持者原来是中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴。阿里巴巴是一个巨无霸企业，业务范围广泛。它还联合创办了一个与中国军方关系密切的人工智能实验室，那里的研究人员从事过自动化网络攻击和模拟兵棋推演等任务。

For the past several weeks, Nvidia has been convulsed by revelations that Mr. Huang had an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, whom U.S. officials say is an asset for Chinese intelligence and was passing information to Beijing. But beneath the scandal is a geopolitical tug of war over access to the advanced Nvidia chips that help power the global A.I. boom.

过去几周，有关黄仁勋与黄乐婚外情的消息曝光后，英伟达陷入了剧烈动荡。美国官员称，黄乐是中国情报机构的线人，一直向北京传递情报。但在这桩丑闻背后，还存在一场围绕先进英伟达芯片获取渠道展开的地缘政治角力。这些芯片是推动全球人工智能热潮的重要技术基础。

The web of relationships between Megaspeed, Alibaba and Nvidia exposes a supply chain that often circumvents efforts by the United States to keep those chips out of China’s reach. The fact that Alibaba has access to the Nvidia chips and is only one step removed from the military-linked A.I. lab is exactly what intelligence officials in Washington have long feared. The technology could help China develop more sophisticated weapons, carry out cyberattacks and integrate A.I. into the battlefield.

Other Chinese tech giants have created similar arrangements to access Nvidia chips. In Southeast Asia, data center companies including DayOne, Bridge Data Centers and Aolani provide computing power to customers based in China, according to public records and people familiar with the deals.

其他中国科技巨头也建立了类似的安排，以获取英伟达芯片。根据公开记录和熟悉相关交易的人士透露，在东南亚，DayOne、Bridge Data Centers和Aolani等数据中心公司向位于中国的客户提供算力。

DayOne and Bridge Data Centers did not respond to requests for comment. Aolani declined to comment about its customers.

DayOne和Bridge Data Centers没有回复置评请求。Aolani拒绝就其客户发表评论。

Now the future of the boom has been thrown into question. American officials recently strengthened export rules to prevent companies like Alibaba from remotely accessing Nvidia’s chips.

如今，这一繁荣的未来前景变得不确定。美国官员最近收紧了出口规定，以阻止阿里巴巴等企业远程使用英伟达芯片。

That puts projects like the YTL facility in Malaysia in the spotlight. YTL’s stock price fell about 20 percent over two weeks as scrutiny grew of Megaspeed’s operations in the country.

这使马来西亚杨忠礼集团的数据中心项目成为关注焦点。随着Megaspeed在马来西亚的运营受到越来越严格的审查，杨忠礼集团的股价在两周内下跌了约20%。

If things go bad for Megaspeed, Alibaba put a contingency in place. A business agreement between an Alibaba subsidiary and Megaspeed pledges all servers, chips, intellectual property, and other equipment back to Alibaba if Megaspeed fails to meet its contractual obligations.

如果Megaspeed的经营出现问题，阿里巴巴也已准备好后备方案。阿里巴巴一家子公司与Megaspeed签订的商业协议规定，如果Megaspeed未能履行合同义务，其所有服务器、芯片、知识产权及其他设备都将转归阿里巴巴所有。

Ana Swanson自华盛顿对本文有报道贡献。

孟建国(Paul Mozur)是时报全球科技记者，常驻台北。此前，他自香港、上海和首尔报道亚洲科技与政治的交叉议题。

Adam Satariano是时报科技记者，常驻伦敦。
